# Workspace Guidance

- This is a static portfolio built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Keep it dependency-free unless the project requirements change.
- Preserve semantic markup, keyboard accessibility, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion support.
- The AFRODONKE profile, contact details, and gallery photos come from user-provided content; preserve the local gallery assets and confirm consent for identifiable students before publishing.
- Open `index.html` directly in a browser. No build task or extension is required.
